mapper.select: select id, account_name as accountName, account_no as accountCode, subsidy_type as accountType, bank_name as bankName, balance, status, del_flag as delFlag, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from finance_account where del_flag = '0' and status = '1' and subsidy_type = #{subsidyType} limit 1
mapper.update: update finance_account set balance = balance + #{amount}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and status = '1'
